observations: Saved backend preferences freeze at submission and later edits do not rewrite the queued job; native model launcher held.
Unavailable Vulkan makes one CPU attempt with requested backend and fallback reason retained.
A failed offload gets one CPU attempt; cancellation, changed weights and host-memory guard failures never retry.
Device parser retains driver name and reported budget separately, and marks software-only Vulkan.
Linux Vulkan supervisor reaps its real child on completion and on a simulated resident-budget breach; no large allocation or model used.
Actual bundled Vulkan worker executes device discovery here and reports no physical device; no running inference is fabricated.
